question.text: If a tangent having slope <math><mn>2</mn></math> of the ellipse <math><mi mathvariant="normal"></mi><mfrac><mrow><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></mrow><mrow><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></mrow></mfrac><mo>+</mo><mfrac><mrow><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">y</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></mrow><mrow><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">b</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></math> is normal to the circle <math><mi mathvariant="normal"></mi><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">y</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>4</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>0,</mn></math> then the value of <math><mn>4</mn><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">b</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></math> is equal to

solution.text:
Equation of tangent is y=2x±4a2+b2
This is normal to the circle x2+y2+4x+1=0
This tangent passes through -2,0
0=-4±4a2+b2⇒4a2+b2=16
